dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped annuli with high-contrast sharp outer perimeters; the mid-dorsal structures exhibit jagged, non-uniform edges transitioning to diffuse lighter grey interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, localized solid-white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, concentrated predominantly on the posterior dorsal and lower lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis, while the cluster of posterior blobs forms a dense, irregular polygonal arrangement.
